notes.title: Update Notes for March 4, 2022
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Skybox3D update 0.40 is here! In this update we bring a few new features in addition to bug fixes and improvements.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/4e4c72d347da65a876742ba353d61041c4ff9f8f.gif

New features

 Timeline Marker
Hovering on any timeline marker will show a description of what happens at that point in time. 
Clicking on the timeline marker will focus the camera at the position and time of the event. The affected player will be selected to help focusing on the event.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/ce2ce6c3049459afdaeaa409dfd6022a8c733319.jpg


Auto camera rotate
Enable automatic camera rotation and control the speed via Sidebar > Camera. You can also toggle the rotation with the shortcut - "Shift + R".

Checkout out the Timeline Marker and Auto camera rotation in this video: 
[previewyoutube=cPMMbo3BAeg;full][/previewyoutube]


 System Feedback
Some user actions will invoke visual feedback notes. A note will appear over the timeline, describing the action taken.

 Match Info tab
Added simple player statistics, shortcut - "Tab". 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/0ef77bd078a6656c22d71b3798fda5c93d570a92.jpg



Updates

 Dust 2 update
The Dust 2 map was updated to match the CS:GO map update released on 2021 November 7th. 
Previous versions are still available, when older matches are played.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/3c340f4771eb0a922a1f2e0364ad7588933b59c3.gif

 Change graphical UI with the shortcuts
Advanced mode off: Shift+S (S for simple)
Advanced mode on: Shift+N (N for normal)
The following works if the Skybox3D Pro is activated:
Broadcaster: Shift+B
Telestrator: Shift+T

notes.title: Update Notes for January 21, 2022
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. Skybox3D update 0.38 was just released and it brings a few new features and improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/5ab72c5c99b41812ca4049e255b6705947282dda.jpg

New Features

 C4 visibility across different camera modes, enable in Sidebar - Visual Tools - Show C4

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/d84f6d94f3c194fcd7c8a74870af1c560394a153.jpg

Improvements

 Custom Broadcaster camera updates.
Ability to rename, delete individual camera and assign shortcut was added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/f7f158c940819c10d70c3ca45b285b10412afeb5.jpg


 Improvements to the Overview mode
[olist]
 C4 is now always visible
 Grenade icon visibility, toggle via Sidebar - Visual Tools - Grenade Icons
[/olist]

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40545953/a114ea93eccce43a2488d5aefe506d2a51838dd3.jpg


 Complete timeline control via shortcuts. See picture bellow.
